description: Catches recorded by anglers on the portal (species, length, weight, date, water, whether released, angler's public name, page URL), optionally for one water or river and one species, ordered by length, weight or date. Exact catch spots are never returned. Entries are supplied by anglers.

lang.description: Language of the answer: texts and page URLs in this language. sk = Slovak (original), cs = Czech, en = English, de = German, pl = Polish, hu = Hungarian, uk = Ukrainian, es = Spanish, fr = French, ro = Romanian, it = Italian. Use the language of the user. If omitted, the language of the input is used when it can be recognised, otherwise Slovak.

order.description: length = longest first (default), weight = heaviest first, recent = newest first.

species.description: Optional species name in any supported language or Latin, e.g. "kapor", "carp", "Sander lucioperca".

water_id.description: Optional page id of a fishing water, river or basin.

name: list_catches
title: Recorded catches and records
